title: ‘You Can See Everything’ has made more than $100M worldwide | TechCrunch
summary: “You Can See Everything,” Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes , reached an impressive box office milestone this weekend, becoming one of the few documentaries to make more than $100 million worldwide.
